body:
I've added this to our gRPC blocking tests -- which afais look the same as this reproducer
* https://github.com/alesj/quarkus/commit/7d3590a478088c53759baabdbd8281810cd56df5
... yet all works as expected ...
Ah, I see reproducer service code throws an exception ... let me try that.

OK, this branch reproduces the issue ...
* https://github.com/alesj/quarkus/tree/block_grpc1

We need to have a `fail()` call after [this line](https://github.com/alesj/quarkus/blob/cd38b916b7d0e979d45968d088e5ae221f735a6f/extensions/grpc/deployment/src/test/java/io/quarkus/grpc/server/blocking/BlockingMethodsTest.java#L97). Otherwise the test might pass incorrectly if it doesn't throw any exception.

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: You're not allowed!
	at io.quarkus.grpc.server.services.BlockingTestService.unaryCallBlocking(BlockingTestService.java:64)
	at io.quarkus.grpc.blocking.BlockingTestServiceGrpc$MethodHandlers.invoke(BlockingTestServiceGrpc.java:1009)
	at io.grpc.stub.ServerCalls$UnaryServerCallHandler$UnaryServerCallListener.onHalfClose(ServerCalls.java:182)
	at io.quarkus.grpc.runtime.supports.blocking.BlockingExecutionHandler.call(BlockingExecutionHandler.java:43)
	at io.quarkus.grpc.runtime.supports.blocking.BlockingExecutionHandler.call(BlockingExecutionHandler.java:11)
	at io.vertx.core.impl.ContextImpl.lambda$executeBlocking$0(ContextImpl.java:178)
	at io.vertx.core.impl.ContextInternal.dispatch(ContextInternal.java:279)
	at io.vertx.core.impl.ContextImpl.lambda$internalExecuteBlocking$2(ContextImpl.java:210)
	at io.vertx.core.impl.TaskQueue.run(TaskQueue.java:76)
	at io.quarkus.vertx.core.runtime.VertxCoreRecorder$14.runWith(VertxCoreRecorder.java:599)
```

issue.title: Reorder Grpc server interceptors to apply exception handler correctly
